title: Logs you can hand to an AI: building Agent Idea.
description: How we built a logger that refuses personal data and a service that sanitises logs, so people and Claude can read them safely.
summary: A logger that refuses personal data, and a service that cleans up whatever gets through, so Claude can read our logs safely.
lede: We wanted to read every product’s logs from one place, and to let Claude read them too, without any personal data leaving. That took two tools: a logger that refuses personal data, and a service that cleans up whatever gets through.
